item_name: Rothco 3-In-1 Adjustable Double Layer Fleece Balaclava
item_short_desc: Stay warm and versatile with Rothco’s 3-In-1 Adjustable Double Layer Fleece Balaclava. Designed for maximum flexibility, this balaclava can be worn in multiple ways, including as an open or closed balaclava, a neck gaiter, hat, or face mask. The built-in internal cord adjustment allows you to easily customize the fit to your needs, making it ideal for snowboarding, running, hiking, and a variety of other outdoor activities.
description: Stay warm and versatile with Rothco’s 3-In-1 Adjustable Double Layer Fleece Balaclava. Designed for maximum flexibility, this balaclava can be worn in multiple ways, including as an open or closed balaclava, a neck gaiter, hat, or face mask. The built-in internal cord adjustment allows you to easily customize the fit to your needs, making it ideal for snowboarding, running, hiking, and a variety of other outdoor activities. Made from a double layer of soft polar fleece, this balaclava provides superior insulation, keeping you warm in cold weather conditions. Measuring 15 inches in length, it offers full coverage to protect your face, neck, and head from harsh winds and frigid temperatures. Whether you're hitting the slopes or simply braving winter weather, Rothco’s 3-In-1 Balaclava ensures you stay comfortable, warm, and protected.
